title: Required proof dimensions and their method-specific gates
scopeNotes: A smaller numerical endpoint does not imply every analytic dimension improved.
Capacity slope, intercept, admissible domain and source eligibility must be compared together.
An inherited theorem used by a new consumer is distinct from a new analytic estimate.
Verification is categorical evidence, not a numerical strength score.
The radar footprint marks where a method changes the proof; its area is not a mathematical quality metric.
No single universal LOW/HIGH or moment formula is asserted for incomparable methods.
Admission status can change after this snapshot; the live catalogue and exact-head certificate are authoritative.

bottleneck.assessment: Global LOW is deliberately balanced at θ, and limiting moment capacity uses its plane boundary. Among the three comparable final-row guarantees, the top-row certificate has the smallest positive reserve. These facts identify constraints to inspect; they do not prove an optimized global bottleneck or that all remaining improvement is exhausted.
bottleneck.scope: Audit of selected scalar identities, certified interval reserves and actual source contracts for the admitted 21871/25000 proof. Six analytic dimensions share constraints. Only the three final-row guarantees share the θ−E scale. Internal source-LOW/HIGH payments belong to the moment construction. Numerical optimization, exact global minima and cross-normalization reserve rankings are not claimed.
